decisions.reason: The Demeter natural yogurt extends an established biodynamic range at low incremental cost and is still featured on the website two years after launch, so this option is cheap to hold and its value appears to be materializing.

The mild sliced cheese launched only in 2024 and has its own product page, so its market value is still uncertain while keeping it costs little within the existing organic dairy portfolio, which favors keeping the option open.
The sliced butter cheese is a recent, low-cost line extension whose results do not yet show whether demand will hold, so abandoning it now would give up the option before its uncertainty resolves.
